say.zh: 这一年，你在山上修行。没有差事，不下山。
say.en: This year you cultivate on the mountain. No errand, no going down.

summary.zh: 头场雪夜，饭桶闻了一口官丹；开春，一炉残株出了三颗九转筑基丹。清明六层，端午七层，伏天八层，入秋九层圆满。瞿老讲了他最后一个徒弟——九月初三，你在崖顶筑基。
summary.en: On the first snowy night the Rice Tub sniffed the sect's pill; in spring one batch of culls gave three nine-turn Foundation pills. Layer six at Qingming, seven at the Dragon Boat festival, eight in the dog days, the peak of nine in autumn. Old Qu told of his last disciple — and on the third of the ninth month you lay your Foundation on the cliff.

intro.zh: 头场雪下了一夜。观主亲手赐的玉盒子，你揣了三天，还没打开。
intro.en: The first snow fell all night. The jade box the abbot gave you with his own hands — you have carried it three days and not opened it yet.

mystery.zh: 瞿老四十多年没收过徒弟——他上一个徒弟，后来怎样了？
mystery.en: Old Qu took no disciple for more than forty years — what became of the last one?

did.zh: 头场雪那一夜，饭桶闻了一口官丹
did.en: On the first snowy night the Rice Tub sniffed the sect's pill

did.zh: 开春一炉，出了三颗九转筑基丹
did.en: one spring batch gave three nine-turn Foundation pills

did.zh: 九月初三，你在崖顶筑了基——师父问几道纹，你说一道
did.en: and on the third of the ninth month you laid your Foundation on the cliff — your master asked how many rings, and you said one

teaser.zh: 却说北边漳水之滨，有一座邺城，城里年年要给河伯娶一回媳妇。今年巫祝挑中的新娘子，是城西卖豆腐的哑女——那时你还不知道，这门亲事，是要你去搅上一搅的。
teaser.en: Up north on the Zhang stands the city of Ye, which marries a bride to the River Lord every year. This year the shaman chose the mute girl who sells tofu on the west side — and you did not yet know that this wedding was yours to spoil.
